mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% and 1.0% respectively over the prior 3 months indicates a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 1.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline as specified.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3%), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4% over the prior 3 months increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rises > 4% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate concerns about corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500.0 thousand units over the prior 3 months indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and real sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% each over the prior 3 months indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline as specified.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2%), a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% over the prior 3 months boosts risk appetite and liquidity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2% and FEDFUNDS declines < 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
